headline: Codelco Evaluates Restructuring and Seeks Private Partners for Copper Exploration
summary: The chairman of state-owned Codelco announced plans to propose a wide-ranging restructuring of the Chilean mining company and selected seven projects out of more than 60 to attract private partners for exploration in order to boost production and recover trust.
why: Codelco is the world's largest state-owned copper producer, and its operational strategy and output figures significantly influence global copper supply and Chile's fiscal revenues.

impacts.name: Codelco
impacts.why: Opening exploration to private partnerships and restructuring aims to revive production capacity.
